summary: UI verification of the new backup + restore work in Admin. Login OK. On /admin/reset-center, all three modes (One account, One shop, Whole app) triggered real browser downloads via page.expect_download with the correct suggested filenames, sizes and result lines. The reset button stayed locked (Step 3 / danger-PIN box hidden) until the download completed, and only appeared afterward — the download gate holds. The new 'RESTORE A BACKUP' heading + 'Restore from a file' card (testID appbackup-pick) is visible at the bottom of the Reset centre. /admin/backup-file correctly redirects to /admin/backups and opens the 'File backup' tab where testID appbackup-download produced a full-app .json (9.3 MB, 1,337 records across 56 collections) with the expected 'Saved N records across M collections (X MB)' result. Regression: /admin/home, /admin/orders, /admin/reset-center all render, no red screen. NOT VERIFIED via UI: the wrong-PIN restore wiring — Playwright set_input_files against expo-document-picker's dynamically-injected & immediately-removed hidden input did not trigger the picker's onChange, so the appbackup-picked box never rendered. This is a testing-tool limitation of RN-Web DocumentPicker, not a code bug; the same file-load path is exercised by hand and by the passing backend test (test_backup_stream_restore.py). No destructive action or PIN entry was performed against protected inputs.

reset_center_one_account.note: Search 'testbuyer' returns testbuyer2@test.com first — file label + email both testbuyer2 (still an account backup, correct behaviour).

verified_flows.step3_download_gate: PASS — reset-pin input only mounts after the download resolves.
verified_flows.restore_card_in_reset_center: PASS — appbackup-pick renders under 'RESTORE A BACKUP' at the bottom of /admin/reset-center.
verified_flows.backup_file_redirect: /admin/backup-file → /admin/backups (File backup tab default). File-backup tab renders both 'Download everything' and 'Restore from a file' cards.

restore_card_wrong_pin_path.reason: expo-document-picker on RN-Web injects a hidden <input type=file>, opens it, and removes it before Playwright's set_input_files change event settles the picker's onChange. As a result appbackup-picked never renders in the automation, so I could not type into appbackup-pin or click appbackup-restore to observe the 'Invalid Danger PIN' dialog.
restore_card_wrong_pin_path.coverage_elsewhere: Backend test /app/backend/tests/test_backup_stream_restore.py already asserts /api/admin/backup/restore returns 401 for a wrong danger_pin and 200 for a correct one across 181 docs. The card renders and its testIDs (appbackup-pick, appbackup-picked, appbackup-mode-merge, appbackup-mode-wipe, appbackup-pin, appbackup-restore) are all present in backup-restore-card.tsx.
restore_card_wrong_pin_path.suggested_manual_check: Load an account file via the picker in a real browser session and confirm merge/wipe options are hidden, button reads 'Restore this account', and 000000 surfaces 'Invalid Danger PIN' via window.confirm.

action_items: Main agent: consider a small hardening tweak in BackupRestoreCard.onPick — on web, retain the <input type=file> node in the DOM for a couple of animation frames after picking so end-to-end tests can drive it through Playwright set_input_files. Not required for users; only for reliable UI automation.

Optional: expose a data-testid on the underlying file input (e.g. via a react-native-web View + <input>) so tests can target it directly instead of relying on document.querySelectorAll('input[type=file]').
critical_code_review_comments: reset-center.tsx line 62 & 77: Alert.alert(...) is used for 'Search failed' / 'Couldn't read the data' — RN Web no-ops these. Everything else in this screen uses notify(); switching these two to notify() would surface the errors to admins on web too.

backup-restore-card.tsx line 176: pickedMeta compares file.scope === 'account' but the takenAt fallback string doesn't handle a missing exported_at timestamp beyond an empty string — harmless, just noting.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (6 of 7 UI assertions covered end-to-end; wrong-PIN wiring not reachable via Playwright due to expo-document-picker on RN-Web)

seed_data_creation: None. Existing testbuyer2@test.com / testvendor@test.com / full DB used read-only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Downloads captured to /tmp/downloads. Reset-center gate, three-mode downloads, redirect from /admin/backup-file, download-everything and the restore card presence are all confirmed. The wrong-PIN chain only fails to run because RN-Web's DocumentPicker input is destroyed before Playwright's file-picker event settles; to test in a future run, either patch the app to expose a testID directly on the <input type=file> or drive the picker via a manual browser session. NEVER type the real Danger PIN and NEVER complete a wipe/reset.
